entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is 788-B45-901.
Okay, let me just pull that up for you. One moment... I see the order here for the Pro-Ride cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Yes. Can I return them or not?
I can certainly look into that for you. So I can process this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
Look, they don't work for me. The fit is wrong where the cleats attach, and they're giving me blisters. I just need a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the delivery date... I see they were delivered 53 days ago.

And that's no problem at all. That's well within our 90-day return policy. I've gone ahead and approved this return. I've just emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you. Simply pack the cycling shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue the full refund back to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
